== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-dengarsblastercarbine-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Dengar's Blaster Carbine]]: The game text changes: “any” becomes “your”; “a character, creature or vehicle” is added after “. May target”; “Character” becomes “Target”; “ability. Vehicle hit if destiny +1 &gt; maneuver or armor” becomes “defense value”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Dengar’s Blaster Carbine” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
